name: Daffodil Bouquet
summary: In Lakeshire, Daffodil Bouquet carries Guard Parker’s thanks to Darcy for packing his lunch. Martie Jainrose gathers the flowers, and her choice stirs gossip between the two women.

sections.title: A Tangled Token
sections.body: Guard Parker wants to thank Darcy at the Lakeshire inn for packing his daily lunch. So he asks Martie Jainrose, the town herbalist, to prepare a bouquet of daffodils. Martie names them her favorite flowers. Darcy recognizes them as Martie’s signature bloom and suspects jealousy. Half-joking, she wonders if Martie poisoned the stems out of spite.

faq.q: What is the Daffodil Bouquet used for?
aliases: what do i do with daffodil bouquet
faq.answer: Guard Parker sends Daffodil Bouquet to Darcy at the Lakeshire inn. It thanks her for packing and sending his lunch while he is on duty.

aliases: where did the flowers come from
faq.answer: Martie Jainrose, Lakeshire’s herbalist, gathers and binds the bouquet at Guard Parker’s request. She chooses daffodils because they are her favorite flowers.

faq.q: Why does Darcy react suspiciously to the flowers?
faq.answer: Darcy recognizes Martie’s favorite flowers and suspects they were not chosen especially for her. She calls Martie a jealous rival and jokes that the stems might be tainted out of spite, yet accepts the gesture.
No. The flowers are harmless. Darcy’s suspicion is theatrical jealousy between the two women in Lakeshire.

angles.text: As an herbalist in Lakeshire, you may recognize Martie Jainrose’s handiwork. She gathers wild flowers for her trade.
